contents.text: I'm opening the runtime view doc at "How a turn works" in the architecture folder, since that's the stop I need to write up now.

This page follows one message from the API through the engine, the model and the packs, and back out as a stream. Every request to the model passes through the same six layers, and the sequence diagram shows them in order. Look at the diagram first, with its tool loop of up to 10 rounds.

The first stop is the whole turn. Your message goes to the API, and the engine runs one turn on it. Its tool loop asks the model and the packs until the answer is ready.

Source: `src/docs/architecture/06-runtime-view.md`
